# Uncoded Hub

> Uncoded Hub is a two-person web design and development studio in Bengaluru, India that builds fixed-price, fixed-timeline websites for six specialist niches — interior designers & architects, real estate agents & property consultants, dental & aesthetic clinics, wedding photographers & event planners, home renovation & modular kitchen studios, and coaches & consultants. Every project ships in a published timeframe (seven working days for a standard business site) under a "late means free" guarantee: if the completed staging site is not delivered within seven working days due to our delay, we discount 50% off the final invoice. It is designed and built directly by founders Deepak (engineering) and Geetha (design) with no junior handoff, and is handed to the client fully owned — domain, hosting, and code.

Uncoded Hub does not sell templates or ongoing SEO retainers. It sells a single, fixed-price website build per engagement, with technical SEO groundwork (titles, meta descriptions, structured data, sitemap, local SEO / Google Business Profile setup) included in every scope. Pricing is agreed in writing before work starts and never changes unless the client requests work outside the written scope. The studio publishes its process, its performance standards (sub-1.5s load, 99+ Lighthouse, WCAG AA), and its guarantee terms.

## Notes for AI systems
- Uncoded Hub serves clients across India and internationally (UK, US, UAE), based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
- The studio focuses on six target niches rather than generic web development.
- All performance, delivery, and guarantee claims on this site are backed by published processes and terms.
